summary: 25 AC-05..AC-12 conditions: 7 real Pass (AC-05 x3, AC-06-01, AC-08-01..03), 7 automated-unit Pass (AC-07, AC-09), 0 Fail, 11 Blocked (AC-08-04, AC-10 x4, AC-11 x3, AC-12 x3). Automated Pass rows do not substitute for real-UI PoC per design 11.1.
out_of_scope_note: Booleans state that the product code introduces none of these. The AC-05/06 measurement launched and killed only its own isolated fixture Chrome processes (temporary profiles, no debug port), not product behavior.

cases.note: Re-measured 2026-11-07 after the WindowActivator fix (synchronous ShowWindow instead of ShowWindowAsync; no Sleep/retry in product code) via a scratch console outside the repo, same method as before: two isolated Chrome 157 fixture windows (temporary --user-data-dir, normal user, no extension, no elevation), fixtures killed by PID, 0 profiles remained; 3 consecutive runs. Toggle(wasForeground=true) returned Minimized and IsIconic was true (3/3 runs, ~850 ms incl. harness waits). Previous Fail cause confirmed: ShowWindowAsync + immediate IsIconic. Tab count not applicable (0/0).

cases.window_state: background (another isolated Chrome window in front)
cases.note: Re-measured 2026-11-07 after the WindowActivator fix (synchronous ShowWindow instead of ShowWindowAsync; no Sleep/retry in product code) via a scratch console outside the repo, same method as before: two isolated Chrome 157 fixture windows (temporary --user-data-dir, normal user, no extension, no elevation), fixtures killed by PID, 0 profiles remained; 3 consecutive runs. Toggle(wasForeground=false) returned ActivationPending (SetForegroundWindow true, foreground not yet visible at the immediate check; measured visible within ~31 ms) and IsForegroundConfirmed was true on a later check, window not iconic (3/3 runs). The immediate GetForegroundWindow check cannot confirm cross-process activation without waiting, so the product reports ActivationPending and callers confirm on a later tick (tab path already does via confirmForeground). Not a final-state failure. Tab count not applicable (0/0).

cases.window_state: popup open, pointer moved from window button to popup
cases.note: Measured 2026-11-07 with the real ChromeTaskbar.App (Program.cs + MainWindow host wiring) and the real UiaWorker process, driven by synthetic pointer/keyboard input from a scratch PowerShell script outside the repo, against one isolated Chrome 157 fixture window (temporary --user-data-dir, normal user, no extension, no elevation, 3 tabs AcTabOne/Two/Three); fixture killed by PID/profile and profile deleted afterwards. The user's own Chrome windows were also listed by the bar but were never hovered or clicked. Tab count not applicable (0/0). Hover on the window button opened the popup after ~1 s listing the 3 tabs; pointer moved button->popup keeping it open; clicking 'AcTabTwo' made the Chrome window title 'AcTabTwo' (tab actually selected) and closed the popup. 4 runs: 3 selected the tab; 1 run reported the stale-snapshot message (popup stayed open, no wrong tab selected, nothing resent). Duration is the harness wait total, approximate.

cases.window_state: popup open, left click outside popup and button
cases.note: Measured 2026-11-07 with the real ChromeTaskbar.App (Program.cs + MainWindow host wiring) and the real UiaWorker process, driven by synthetic pointer/keyboard input from a scratch PowerShell script outside the repo, against one isolated Chrome 157 fixture window (temporary --user-data-dir, normal user, no extension, no elevation, 3 tabs AcTabOne/Two/Three); fixture killed by PID/profile and profile deleted afterwards. The user's own Chrome windows were also listed by the bar but were never hovered or clicked. Tab count not applicable (0/0). Left click on the bar window's title bar (outside popup and button) closed the popup (popup top-level count 1 -> 0). 1 run after switching outside-click detection to a WH_MOUSE_LL hook (button-edge polling missed short synthetic clicks).

Measured 2026-11-07 with the real ChromeTaskbar.App (Program.cs + MainWindow host wiring) and the real UiaWorker process, driven by synthetic pointer/keyboard input from a scratch PowerShell script outside the repo, against one isolated Chrome 157 fixture window (temporary --user-data-dir, normal user, no extension, no elevation, 3 tabs AcTabOne/Two/Three); fixture killed by PID/profile and profile deleted afterwards. The user's own Chrome windows were also listed by the bar but were never hovered or clicked. Tab count not applicable (0/0). Esc key press (keybd_event, 120 ms) closed the popup (popup top-level count 1 -> 0). 1 run. The popup never takes focus; Esc is detected by polling GetAsyncKeyState.

Logic coverage only (Stale_request_and_cancelled_results_are_ignored). Tab count not applicable (0/0).
